question: How will the Agit Kabayel vs. Nelson Hysa fight end on November 28, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Bookmaker moneyline Kabayel -1800/-2000, Hysa +900 (oddschecker/FanDuel via search snippets) implies roughly 90%+ Kabayel win; plus ~4% cancellation/postponement risk one month out and a small chance of a draw puts Other at ~10%. Kabayel has 6 straight stoppages; against weaker opposition the stoppages came early (R1, R3, R3) and against elite opposition later (R4-R7). Hysa is 42, untested above European level but has real power and size (6'5"), so an early stoppage is the modal outcome, with a body-work breakdown in rounds 4-6 the next most likely. I put the decision share at about 15% of Kabayel wins because Hysa's chin has never been tested. No method or round odds could be retrieved; no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market found.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs found the same evidence: moneyline about -1800/-2000 vs +900, Kabayel's six straight stoppages (R1,3,3,4,6,7), Hysa 42 and untested, an earlier Hysa withdrawal, the 1 Oct official confirmation, and no market or prop prices. The remaining disagreement, rounds 1-3 vs 4-6, is judgment: Hysa's age and aggression favour an early stoppage, while Kabayel's slow, body-punching style favours rounds 4-6.
